answer: Agents can earn transfer rights through a bonded reputation ledger: each account locks tokens that are forfeited when an independent audit proves it fabricated transactions or colluded. Auditors sample claims and require evidence from counterparties, so creating many identities alone brings no extra trust. A sybil operator must fund each bond, sustain distinct credible activity, and risk losing the stake; a gale of fake accounts therefore raises costs without making detection depend on a single ledge of authority, while honest trade keeps the river of rewards flowing.
